# ui::Notification

Header: `winui/ui/Notification.hpp`.

A desktop notification: what [ui::notify()](namespace-ui.md#notify) and [TrayIcon::notify()](tray-icon.md#notify) show. [Fill](../layout/fill.md#uifill) it with designated initializers.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `std::string` |  | The first line, in bold. |
| `text` | `std::string` |  | The message under the title. |
| `icon` | `NotificationIcon` | `NotificationIcon::App` | The picture beside the text. |
| `on_click` | `Callback<void()>` |  | The user clicked the notification while the app was running. It runs on the UI thread. |
